blocks.text: Advisory Schedule
Green Day

We will run the advisory schedule today. A reminder to all Juniors and Seniors to report to Fuller Hall during advisory for ALICE training. 9th and 10th graders should report to their advisory locations.
Tomorrow we will have our first Pep Chapel of the year! All students and advisors should report directly to the Alumni Gym by 7:55am. Get ready to get that Topper beat!
Seniors: rise, shine, and get your glow on tomorrow morning at Senior Sunrise at 5:30am! Kick off senior year with the best view and the best crew. Check your email for more details.
Reminder — the 2027 India trip has a meeting in Tinker house after school.

Academy theater is holding a Tech crew meeting for this falls production of “She Kills Monsters” today @ 4pm in the stage craft shop in Morse. So, if you’re interested in building sets, making props, and designing puppets, come to the stage craft room in Morse today at 4pm to find out more. Please email Mr. Kane with any questions.

The Zen Zone meets after school today — and every Thursday — in NH 10 starting at 3:30. Come find your inner calm! This club is open to everyone. Come if you want to relax and learn how to clear your mind of clutter. See Ms. Greenstone with questions.
Chess Club meets today at 3:15 in Streeter 225. Master to novice, all are welcome! That’s chess club, every Thursday at 3:15 in Streeter 225. Any questions, see Mr. Buhner, also in Streeter 225.

In support of our first responders, our home opener football game on Friday night will be themed red, white, and blue! Dress your best to appreciate our emergency service providers and support our football team.
Now it’s time for Michael’s Joke of the Week: What do you call a boomerang that never comes back?…A stick 😊

Happy Birthday today to Sophie White! Happy Birthday tomorrow to Alexander Evans, Enyu Hu, Brady MacQueen, Hannah Santy, Kenyon Sorrell, and Claire Trojano, on Sunday to Lilias Robillard and Fernanda Torres Molina Pinho, and on Monday to Easton Kissinger and Carlie Rondeau!
BOYS GOLF @ JAY PEAK 4:00; please dismiss the team at 1:00
GIRLS GOLF @ LINKS AT LANG FARM 4:00; please dismiss the team at 1:00
JV/VARSITY BOYS SOCCER vs. COLCHESTER 4:30
Green Day
Variety Day

Less than 150 students have had their photo taken for the yearbook as of Tuesday afternoon. Please plan to stop by Fuller Hall stage tomorrow or Friday to have your photo taken. All 9th Graders, Sophomores, and Juniors – regardless of whether you are going to order photos or not — need to have your photo taken for the yearbook.
Juniors and Seniors, St. Laurence University is on campus today for a visit. Please see Naviance or Mrs. LaBounty for details and to register. Be sure to check in with your teacher before attending.

The D&D/TCG Club is looking for more Dungeon Masters! If you have experience with DMing and are interested in running a campaign, please email Mr. O’Brien, find him in his Streeter 266 office, or just show up to tomorrow’s club time in the dining hall at 3:15!

Listen up… Life has many stressors… Homework. Work. Checking your email… and responding to emails! And then add to all these things the weight of gravity constantly pulling you down… you’re cooked! But what if you could be stronger than gravity? Come to Grappling with Gravity; we’ve got the recipe. Every Wednesday from 4:00-5:00 pm in the Field House weight room. Your Aura Gains Await.
The Zen Zone welcomes you tomorrow after school. If you want to cultivate your inner calm, come join us in NH 10 at 3:30. Drop-ins are welcome! See Ms. Greenstone with questions.
Happy Birthday today to Silas Armstrong and Myles Wohlleb!
JV/VARSITY GIRLS SOCCER — HOME vs. CVU 4:30
JV/VARSITY VOLLEYBALL @ BURLINGTON 4:30/6:00; please dismiss the teams at 1:15
MOUNTAIN BIKING @ PROCTOR ACADEMY 2:00; please dismiss the team at 10:45
